title: Soft Vegetable Omelet with Spinach
description: Soft Vegetable Omelet with Spinach. A smaller, easy-to-portion meal for the end of an eating window.
whyItWorks: A modest portion may feel more comfortable near the end of an eating window. Fasting schedules are not appropriate for everyone.

ingredients.item: Primary ingredient for Soft Vegetable Omelet
Water or plain yogurt as appropriate
Vegetables or fruit suitable for the dish

steps: Wash and measure the ingredients; cook any raw animal proteins thoroughly.
Prepare the main ingredients using the traditional method suitable for the named dish.
Combine with the measured vegetables and serve as one portion.
